subject.title: fix(cli): warn that attach --print-config prints a live bearer token

question: Should `attach --print-config` continue emitting the live token with this unconditional stderr warning, or should the command also require or provide a log-safe/redacted output policy?
rationale: The existing workflow intentionally emits a usable credential, while warning, redaction, and safe-summary designs have different compatibility and security consequences that repository evidence cannot choose automatically.

options.title: Accept The Warning
options.body: Merge after real terminal proof, preserving the JSON stdout contract while accepting one new stderr warning as the minimal mitigation.

options.title: Add A Log-Safe Mode
options.body: Require an explicit redacted or summary option so users can produce support evidence without exposing a live token.

options.title: Redesign Secret Handoff
options.body: Pause this PR and stop printing the live token directly, accepting a larger compatibility change to the documented manual-launch workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept The Warning
recommendation.body: Merge after real terminal proof, preserving the JSON stdout contract while accepting one new stderr warning as the minimal mitigation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the attach grant and launcher contracts and was already routed the policy question in the PR discussion.
